title: Sauna Traditions of the World
subtitle: Reference ranges and customs for 28 sauna and bathing traditions
description:
A small reference dataset of sweat-bathing and hot-bathing traditions: Finnish sauna, smoke sauna, Russian banya, Baltic pirtis and pirts, German Aufguss sauna, hammam, Japanese sento and onsen, Korean jjimjilbang, temazcal and more. Each row gives the heat source, typical temperature and humidity ranges, rituals, cooling practice, UNESCO status and whether headwear is traditionally worn. A second table lists types of bath headwear.

These are compiled reference ranges from general published descriptions, not measurements. Cells are left empty where sources disagree. Version 1.0 (2026-11). Published by DIVELUX, makers of wool sauna hats: https://diveluxsaunahat.com/pages/sauna-tools
